<thought>Using the DBE formula DBE = (2C + 2 + N - H)/2 for C7H12NO gives (14+2+1-12)/2 = 5/2 = 2.5, which is not an integer. The compound is likely a protonated amine, so the neutral formula would be C7H11NO, yielding DBE = (14+2+1-11)/2 = 6/2 = 3. Therefore the integer DBE is 3.</thought>
<final_answer>3</final_answer>
